description:
Say whether each service typically needs a building permit, with typical
    fees, and (when a state is given) the state's building code, code authority
    and contractor licensing resources.

    When to use: the homeowner asks whether a job needs a permit, or how to
    check a contractor's license in their state.
    Limits: typical requirements only; local rules vary, so confirm with the
    local building department. General guidance, not legal advice.

    Args:
        services: Services being planned, e.g. ["roofing", "electrical"].
        state: Two-letter US state code, e.g. "PA".
name: get_permit_guidance
title: Get permit guidance
